text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (My lungs are burning!)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And coming around the final corner from
the
outside is Narita Taishin! Looks like
she's
struggling to get a good position!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
She likely has no choice but to run on
the outside.
With her stature, it'll be
impossible to escape the
pack if she gets
trapped inside.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The racers are going all out in the final
stretch!
Number seven, Walkie Talkie,
and number
eleven, Poisonous, are
battling for the lead!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And there's Narita Taishin! Here she
comes! She's
desperately trying to close
in on the lead, but will
it be enough?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line, it's number
eleven!
Poisonous claims first! Wow,
listen to those cheers
echoing through
the racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Aw, Narita Taishin got fifth? She just
can't get a
break.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Can you blame her? Even the
commentator said
she's at a
disadvantage.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: I mean, just look at how small she is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Not another one of those dreams.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh. This is the worst...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn... Taishin? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Creek!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Having trouble sleeping? Want to drink
some hot
milk with me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine! I'm gonna step out for a sec.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sorry for waking you up. Later.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I feel better now, but I'm still a little
restless. I
keep having those horrible
dreams lately.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(And I've got my debut race coming up
soon...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's because my debut is almost here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit. Now's really not the time to be

doubting myself!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day my journey to tackle the
Twinkle
Series with Narita Taishin
begins!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do my best for her and
bring out the
full potential of her final
sprint!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's time to start training. What are
you
doing standing there like a tool?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ew, what's with that sappy, starry-eyed
look?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Man, you're annoying...
choice_data_list: タイシン！今日から頑張ろうな！
タイシン！今日から頑張ろうね！

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, whatever. Let's just get started
already.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin is as cool as ever today...
However!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff, wheeze... Phew.
choice_data_list: （やっぱり、君の末脚はすごい……！）
（やっぱり、貴方の末脚はすごい……！）

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: How was my time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah? Then...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: デビュー戦でみんなを驚かせよう！

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Easy for you to say. You're too chill
about this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Do you actually understand what the
Twinkle
Series is like?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Tracen is filled with god-tier racers, and
even
then, only a select few from here
qualify to
compete in it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's the kind of race we're facing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
choice_data_list: でも、君の脚は絶対通用する！
でも、貴方の脚は絶対通用する！

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. You airheaded birdbrain.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
First of all, just "stunning" everyone's not
gonna
cut it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I have to use my skills to thrash anyone
who talks
smack about size.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
That'll make every last one of them think
twice
about me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Narita Taishin's fierce
declaration marks
the beginning of her
new challenges.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, can you do something about that
vibe of
yours? It's overkill, and you're
seriously getting
on my nerves.
